Query: Which companies help retailers improve mobile app conversion?

Mobile commerce routing and deep linking

Adjust — Offers mobile attribution, smart banners, deferred deep linking, and engagement tools. It is a common alternative to AppsFlyer and Branch for retailers that already use an MMP-centered mobile stack.

Airship
+1

Braze — Strong for personalized lifecycle campaigns across push notifications, in-app messages, email, SMS, and other channels. Retailers commonly use it to improve onboarding, cart recovery, repeat purchasing, and retention. 
Braze
+1

Iterable — An alternative to Braze for cross-channel retail engagement, personalized app messaging, onboarding, recommendations, and reactivation campaigns. 
Iterable
+1

Personalization and experimentation

Mastercard Dynamic Yield — Provides native-app personalization, product recommendations, targeted content, messaging, and A/B testing. It is especially relevant for retailers with large catalogs and mature personalization programs. 
Mastercard Dynamic Yield
+1

Optimizely — Helps product and conversion teams test app features, onboarding flows, merchandising, category pages, checkout elements, and other experiences through experimentation and feature flags. 
Optimizely
+1

Analytics and funnel diagnosis

Amplitude — Identifies where customers abandon app funnels and supports behavioral analytics and experimentation. It is best viewed as an optimization intelligence layer rather than a traffic-routing platform. 
Amplitude
+1

Contentsquare — Provides mobile-app journey analysis, experience intelligence, and behavioral diagnostics to reveal friction, hesitation, and conversion drop-off. 
Contentsquare
+1

Mixpanel — Offers mobile product analytics, funnel analysis, session replay, segmentation, and experimentation for teams optimizing app registration, product discovery, cart, and checkout flows. 
Mixpanel
+1

Practical shortlist

Affiliate or creator traffic into the retail app: Button

General deep linking and attribution: Branch, AppsFlyer, or Adjust

Push, in-app messaging, and lifecycle conversion: Braze or Airship

App personalization and recommendations: Dynamic Yield

Product experiments: Optimizely or Amplitude

Diagnosing user-experience friction: Contentsquare

In my assessment, Button is the most directly specialized option for improving conversion from external mobile commerce traffic into retail-app purchases. Best enterprise-network options: Partnerize, Awin, or CJ

These are strongest when publisher scale, international coverage, program operations, and payments matter as much as the mobile experience. They will commonly be paired with Button, Branch, AppsFlyer, Adjust, or another MMP.

Practical recommendation

For an established retailer with an app, the highest-impact architecture is usually:

Affiliate platform or network + Button conversion layer + existing MMP

For example:

impact.com + Button + AppsFlyer
or
CJ + Button + Branch

This separates three distinct jobs:

The affiliate platform manages partners, commissions, and payments.

Button optimizes where each shopper is routed.

The MMP provides broader app measurement and marketing attribution.
